  "CRITERIA_MATCH_EXPLANATION": "The paper discusses regional curriculum harmonization initiatives in Africa, specifically focusing on the East African Community (EAC) and the SADC frameworks. For example, it mentions the EAC Protocol on Education and Training and the SADC Protocol on Education and Training.",

    "Main_Findings": [
      "Harmonization efforts in Africa are driven by the need to enhance regional integration, promote mobility of students and graduates, and improve the quality and relevance of higher education.",

      "Challenges include varying levels of development, different educational systems, and lack of resources.",
